From: PolarLink Customer Operations <ops@polarlink.example>
To: Station Manager, Katabatic Station <manager@kat.sprc.example>
Cc: IT, Katabatic Station <it@kat.sprc.example>
Date: 2026-01-12
Subject: Service change notice: KAT-VSAT-1 contract renewal, effective dates

Dear Dr. Achebe,

Thank you for renewing the Katabatic Station Ku-band service for the 2026-2028
term. This notice summarises the changes that take effect under the new
contract. Please circulate to your technical staff.

1. Committed information rate. From 2026-03-01 the KAT-VSAT-1 service moves
   from 20 Mbit/s down / 5 Mbit/s up to 25 Mbit/s down / 8 Mbit/s up. No action
   is needed at your end; the modem profile is pushed remotely.

2. Beacon frequency change. As part of the transponder reallocation on our
   southern beam, the pointing beacon moves from 12.199 GHz to 12.246 GHz on
   2026-07-01. Any local alignment procedure that references the old beacon
   frequency should be updated before that date. The data carrier is not
   affected.

3. NOC contact. The 24-hour NOC number is unchanged. Email escalations should
   now go to noc-south@polarlink.example rather than the general address.

4. Hardware RMA. Our hardware partner has confirmed the outstanding RMA for the
   storage drive (case PLK-RMA-20241003) remains open pending physical return.
   We understand this will ship on the 2027-01 resupply. The replacement unit
   has been consigned to the SPRC October 2026 relief flight.

Kind regards,
PolarLink Customer Operations
